footnote_text: Pursuant to the Agreement and Plan of Merger, dated as of February 9, 2026 (the "Merger Agreement"), whereby Madison Merger Sub Inc., a wholly-owned subsidiary of Madison Parent Inc. ("Parent"), merged with and into the Issuer (the "Merger"), with the Issuer surviving as a wholly-owned subsidiary of Parent, each share of the Issuer's common stock ("Common Stock") outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the Merger, was converted into the right to receive an amount in cash equal to $2.43 per share, and each outstanding award of restricted stock units ("RSUs") of the Issuer, was cancelled and converted into the right to receive an amount in cash amount equal to $2.43 multiplied by the total number of shares subject to such award (the "RSU Consideration"). || Pursuant to the Merger Agreement, each award of RSUs issued in lieu of cash retainers outstanding immediately prior to the effective time of the Merger, was converted into the RSU Consideration.
